definition: Aslı Çelikyılmaz is an engineer specializing in natural language processing, and particularly in natural language generation for software agents with advanced reasoning and real-world modeling capabilities.
details: Educated in Turkey and Canada, she works in the US as senior research lead at Fundamentals AI Research, Meta. She also holds an affiliate faculty position in computer science at the University of Washington, and is co-editor-in-chief of the journal Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics.

explainer.lead: Aslı Çelikyılmaz is an engineer and research leader working on how computers produce natural language. Her focus on language generation for reasoning software agents matters because such agents must communicate what they are doing in ways people can understand.

tiers.eli5: Aslı Çelikyılmaz helps computers learn to put their ideas into words. It is a bit like teaching a robot not only to solve a puzzle, but also to explain its answer clearly. She studies this for software agents that can reason and build an understanding of the real world.
tiers.practitioner: Her work applies natural language generation to software agents with advanced reasoning and real-world modeling capabilities. For an engineer, the central challenge is connecting generated language to the agent's reasoning and world model rather than treating text output as an isolated step. She leads research at Meta and also holds academic and journal-editorial roles.
tiers.paperLevel: The research problem can be described as natural language generation for software agents: producing natural language from an agent's reasoning and its model of the real world. It sits within natural language processing, with an emphasis on agents whose language capabilities are linked to those internal capabilities.

explainer.example: Consider a software agent that has reasoned through a task using its model of the real world. Natural language generation is the part that lets it turn that internal result into a clear explanation for a person, which is the setting emphasized in Çelikyılmaz's work.
